name: Twig Blight

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual has a newer block that isn't in SRD 5.2.1; this one keeps the 2014 numbers until it can be checked against the book. Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual block (the one Curse of Strahd uses); the 2024 changes are not entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Blind beyond its blindsight.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.summary: Motionless, it looks just like a dead shrub.
traits.text: While the blight stays still, nothing tells it apart from a dead, dry shrub.

summary: A knee-high bundle of dead twigs that passes for brush until it scuttles out to claw; fire burns it badly.
